result.summary: The page is largely functional and well laid out, with two likely content defects: an empty/unrendered decorative element in the promo banner and an implausible '-100%' discount badge on a menu card.

issues.description: The promo banner contains an empty green circular shape on the right side that looks like an unrendered image placeholder or a graphic element missing its image.
issues.suggestion: Remove the empty circle or replace it with the intended promotional artwork/icon.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card shows a discount badge reading '-100%', which is likely an incorrect or malformed discount value.
issues.suggestion: Verify the discount data and correct the badge so it displays a plausible value (for example, '-10%') or remove it if no discount applies.
